dedupe_keys.name: sunbird dcim data centre infrastructure management software

description: Sunbird DCIM is a data centre infrastructure management (DCIM) platform from Sunbird Software. Sunbird describes DCIM as software that replaces spreadsheets, diagrams and home-grown databases by bringing together data from data centre operations, facilities and IT. Its platform polls power and environmental equipment, trends and reports readings and alerts on threshold violations; models capacity so users can find space, power and network ports for new servers and identify stranded power; keeps an inventory of IT and facilities assets with power and network connectivity diagrams; calculates and trends power usage effectiveness (PUE) from building, IT and non-IT loads; and visualises racks and rooms. Its models library covers a wide range of equipment, physical media, protocols, network speeds and connectors, and APIs link it to third-party configuration management databases and ticketing systems. Coverage: any data centre. Format and access: commercial software, with a free online test drive. Caveats: proprietary; the page read is a general explainer, so product details such as module names (dcTrack for asset and capacity management, Power IQ for monitoring) are from recall. Simulation uses: operational data and capacity models for data centre power and cooling, which can feed studies of how grid outages or heat waves affect IT loads. Related records: Nlyte DCIM, Hyperview and Schneider EcoStruxure IT are comparable products, and the EN 50600 standards record covers data centre design.
